blurb: Livin' the Dream Guide Service offers guided fishing trips on Minnesota lakes including Leech Lake, Gull Lake, and the Brainerd Lakes Area, specializing in walleye, musky, and bass. They also provide inshore saltwater fishing charters in Fort Myers, Florida targeting species like snook, redfish, tarpon, and goliath grouper. Trips include all gear, tackle, bait, and fishing licenses, with expert guides tailoring the experience to the season and client skill level.
